rationale.text: One optgroup has a label attribute with text, the other a label attribute with an empty value. The test asks only whether each optgroup possesses a label attribute; the content of that attribute is the subject of test 11.8.3, which applies to each optgroup having a label attribute. Both possess it, so this test is met. The custom check answers no_fault whatever the value (step 6), so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only. With the labelled case, this is the first half of the mixed pair.
